frame.converter: Each sky position onto the plane the picture stands on, facing the Sun (recipe.json), through the image-layer bake's own intersection.

bulge.basis: Old objects fill the bulge as well as the disc: each is a bulge member with the bulge's share of S4G's fitted light at its sky position (faded out between 12.64 and 18.06 kpc as the image layers' is), and then sits at a depth drawn from the bulge's density along its sight line. Membership is drawn, not measured.

meaning: Globular clusters of the Sombrero Galaxy that Spitler et al. (2006) catalogued in a Hubble mosaic: one dot per cluster at its catalogue position.

appearance.note: Presentation only: the Milky Way globular clusters' warm orange. Each dot takes its tone and half its color from the photograph under it (packages/bake/cli/prepare-catalogue-points.mts).
